schema_objects.Name: assets
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE assets (
 asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(asset_id)=38 AND substr(asset_id,1,6)='asset_' AND substr(asset_id,7) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(asset_id,7)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(label AS BLOB))<=4096 AND instr(label,char(0))=0),
 head TEXT,
 created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 updated_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 CHECK(created_sequence>0 AND updated_sequence>=created_sequence),
 FOREIGN KEY(asset_id,head) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(library_id)=36 AND substr(library_id,1,4)='lib_' AND substr(library_id,5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(library_id,5)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 ready INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ready IN (0,1))
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_admin_events
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog_admin_events (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(operation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND operation_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 request BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(request)='blob' AND length(request) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576),
 payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64 AND payload_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recorded_unix_nano INTEGER NOT NULL,
 receipt BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt)='blob' AND length(receipt) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048)
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_admin_events_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_admin_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_admin_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_admin_events_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_admin_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_admin_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_authority
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog_authority (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 incarnation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(incarnation)=37 AND substr(incarnation,1,5)='auth_' AND substr(incarnation,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(incarnation,6)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 owner_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_subjects(subject_id)
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_authority_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authority_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_authority WHEN NEW.singleton<>OLD.singleton OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.owner_subject_id<>OLD.owner_subject_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_authority_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authority_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_authority BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority lifetime identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_credentials
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog_credentials (
 selector TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(selector)=37 AND substr(selector,1,5)='cred_' AND substr(selector,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(selector,6)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 incarnation TEXT NOT NULL,
 subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_subjects(subject_id),
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('library','asset')),
 asset_id TEXT REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 actions BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(actions)='blob' AND length(actions) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
 verifier BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(verifier)='blob' AND length(verifier)=32),
 issued_unix INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_unix INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_unix>issued_unix),
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
 revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revoked IN (0,1)),
 CHECK((scope_kind='library' AND asset_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind='asset' AND asset_id IS NOT NULL))
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_credentials_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_credentials_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_credentials WHEN NEW.selector<>OLD.selector OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.incarnation<>OLD.incarnation OR NEW.subject_id<>OLD.subject_id OR NEW.scope_kind<>OLD.scope_kind OR NEW.asset_id IS NOT OLD.asset_id OR NEW.actions<>OLD.actions OR NEW.verifier<>OLD.verifier OR NEW.issued_unix<>OLD.issued_unix OR NEW.expires_unix<>OLD.expires_unix OR OLD.revoked<>0 OR NEW.revoked<>1 OR NEW.generation<>OLD.generation+1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_credentials_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_credentials_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_credentials BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority lifetime identity'); END

schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog WHEN OLD.ready<>0 OR NEW.ready<>1 OR NEW.singleton<>OLD.singleton OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: locations
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE locations (

schema_objects.Name: locations_identity

 removed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(removed IN (0,1)),
 CHECK(created_sequence>0 AND updated_sequence>=created_sequence),
 FOREIGN KEY(source_asset_id,source_revision) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(target_asset_id,target_revision) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id)
)
